description_en: This operation queries the channels of a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-caster-channels --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCasterChannels

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation to create a production studio, use the CasterId returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page to view the ID.

The name of a production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the ID of the production studio
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

ChannelId.description_en:
The ID of the channel slot used in the layout. You can set a maximum of one video source for each slot. The ID must be in the format of RV01 to RV12.

The ID of the channel that is used in the layout. You can set a maximum of one video source for each slot. The ID must be in the format of RV01 to RV12
ChannelId.description_zh:
通道位置ID。

布局应用通道ID，每个位置至多设置一个视频源，格式需符合“RV01~RV12”

FaceBeauty.description_en: The retouching settings. Valid values: 0 (whole), 1 (skin smoothing), 2 (skin whitening), 3 (dark circle removal), and 4 (nasolabial fold removal)

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the video source

StreamUrl.description_en: The output URL of the channel
